messages:
Olivia: Quick check — proposing a 'hopscotch order' for Wed's RFC review so authors rotate earlier/later slots. Who's on deck for reviews?
Matt: I can take 2 or 3. Prefer an earlier slot (9:30-10) if possible.
Jyoti: 9:30 works for me. Also can we move pre-read reminder to 48h? Authors skipped uploads last round.
Kevin: Pinged authors already. Draft agenda snippet:
```
09:30 - RFC: streaming-cache (author: @Olivia) - 15m
09:50 - RFC: quant-mode (author: @Samer) - 20m
10:15 - RFC: rollout-fallback (author: @Lisa) - 10m + Q&A
```
Olivia: Small ask — add a 'fallback reviewer' column. If primary reviewer drops, fallback takes next slot and we short-circuit ordering.
Lisa: I'll be fallback for quant-mode. Pre-read checklist link: https://r/inference/docs/pre-read-checklist — I'll mark items done.
calendar-bot: calendar: Meeting created Wed 09:30-10:30. Link: https://calendar.company/w/abc :calendar:
Matt: :thumbsup: Can we make rollout-fallback the last item? It's short and good to close on.
Olivia: Sure — updated order in the agenda doc. Reminder to authors: upload pre-reads by Tue 09:30 (48h before).
Jyoti: I'll send the 48h reminder tomorrow morning with a checklist and attachments.
Kevin: If someone can't make their slot, post async notes + tag your reviewer. We'll hop the author forward instead of cancelling.
Olivia: Thanks — final agenda link: https://r/inference/rfcs/agenda-hopscotch. I'll DM any authors who miss the pre-read.
